senses.gloss:
ITA-9.5.23 āścyotanam आश्च्योतनम्
Instillation of eye drops
The instillation of liquid medications in the eye (conjunctival sac).

ITA-5.76.168 āścyotana-apacāraḥ आश्च्योतन-अपचारः
Condition due to improper application of eyedrops

ITA-5.76.169 आश्च्योतन-अयोगः A condition leading to aggravation of the disease.
Condition due to suboptimal application of eyedrops
āścyotana-ayogaḥ

ITA-5.76.170 āścyotanātiyogaḥ आश्च्योतनातियोगः
Condition due to excessive use of eyedrops
A condition characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: eyelids becoming hard and causing crepitus; rubbing friction; difficulty in opening the eyelids; contraction of eyelids; pulsating sensation; winking of eyelids; inability to tolerate wind.
